speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is by the door. Richard the Third, for next week, from the rolls. Each man has his own speeches and three cue-words. No one has the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we run it so. Humphrey, both rolls. Copy them. Do not trust us to remember a word we have only heard.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: My lord.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Stop. That was not your lord.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: It ended as my lord ends.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Come again, Richard. Wait for the whole cue.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: My lord.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And that is the other one. You have entered twice, on two cues, because both of them end alike.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then change one, or change me. I cannot hear a difference that is not there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will change three. Hastings, your cue is no longer my lord. It is Lord Hastings. The next is my liege. The lady's is madam. Three words. Write them on the roll, not in the air.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Three. I have them. Humphrey is copying both rolls, rather than leave this to a memory.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have my words, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast the words, Nick. Thou hast not the breath before the entrance. Take it before thou art seen, or the first word dies on the step.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The air is cold, sir. It takes the breath as I come through the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then take it in the parlour, before the door. The yard owes thee nothing.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Half the voice. Tell me if the room still complains.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The room complains. Thou art too big for it at half. Save the wooing for the yard.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: In the yard I shall not be at half. Thou hast been warned, Will.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are both very large for a parlour. Some of us are the right size, and would like to finish.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: William. Your throat. I can hear it from the cue. Let Cowley take Egeon this afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. I play Egeon. Cowley is not to be thanked for a part I have not given him.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I did not ask for it. I asked for a cue I can tell from another cue.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You will not last the tale. It is the longest old man's story we have, and you have half a voice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will last it on breath and on consonants. The vowels may do as they please.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You will do as you please. That much I have learned, and I am not in a quarrel about it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The three cues stand. Anyone who enters on my lord when we come to play it is in the wrong scene, and I shall say so from the plot.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will breathe before I am seen, sir. I have said the words over.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: See that thy boy does it. A late boy makes a large king look foolish, and I have a limit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will do it. Richard, half is still too much in here. Out in the yard, thou mayest spend it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Lord Hastings. My liege. Madam. I have the three. I will not come in on my lord again.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And at two, you will repent Egeon. I have said it. I will not say it twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it twice if you like. I play him. We are done with the rolls.
